intro.text: An engineering professor and member of the Set.

items.text: Javie had studied engineering and taught before joining the Set. At its compound in Dulsing, built around a wrecked ship, he co-led the engineers with Lady Stansi, hoping to learn how the ship flew. Irich gave them a tour; when talk of dominating the Basin worried Javie, Irich calmed him by appealing to his curiosity.
